# Jeroen Van Goey

> Staff Research Engineer in BioAI building generative models for biology: de novo peptide sequencing, proteomics, and personalized cancer vaccines.

## Pages

- [Home](https://jeroen.vangoey.be/): Staff Research Engineer in BioAI building generative models for biology
- [Writing](https://jeroen.vangoey.be/writing.html): Notes on building ML systems for biology, and the occasional side quest.
- [Photography](https://jeroen.vangoey.be/photography/): Portfolio of portrait, wedding, maternity, boudoir, landscape, and long-exposure photography.

## Writing

- [Teaching an RC car to drive itself](https://jeroen.vangoey.be/posts/donkeycar-jetson-nano/): This page contains my build log for a DonkeyCar running on a Jetson Nano, with the goal of teaching it to drive itself. The log includes all the roadblocks I encountered along the way.

## Projects

- [Self-driving RC car](https://jeroen.vangoey.be/projects/self-driving-rc-car.html): An ongoing project: experiments in training self-driving policies in simulation and deploying them to a Jetson Nano (with a Coral Edge TPU planned). Overview, architecture, and a progress log.

## Work

- [R & Python Platforms](https://jeroen.vangoey.be/work/r-python-platforms.html): Supporting ~480 researchers at BASF, highlighting a deep-learning wheat-peduncle use case.
